goal: Treat database read corruptions as fatal instead of masking them as missing data
Prevent nodes from continuing to run with corrupted index or chainstate records
agreement: Supports simplifying the stack of views (andrewtoth)
Contested objection: aborting the node on optional index corruption takes down working nodes (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: pre-abort callback chain is convoluted and hard to verify thread safety (ajtowns)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because corruptions in secondary indexes stop failing individual queries while keeping bad state
Secondary index failures affect optional queries rather than core consensus

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because storage corruption during coin lookups halts the node instead of acting as missing keys
Prevents silent block validation failures or crashes caused by running with corrupted UTXO data
